sources.name: Psilocybin Mushrooms and U.S. Legal Regulations 2025 - Recovered
Where Are Magic Mushrooms Legal? State-By-State Guide - Trip Sitter

_: Personal use and possession of psychedelics has been made the lowest law enforcement priority in certain cities. Statewide legalization bills have failed but continue to be proposed.
